## ibis/ibis-polars — Relation.join_asof(strategy='forward'\|'nearest') raises BackendCapabilityError on ibis-polars; backward is native and unaffected

Target: `RKEY_MOUNTAINASH_REL.JOIN_ASOF`

### Illustration

    Arguments: {"on": "t", "right": {"relation_ref": "right"}, "strategy": "forward"}
    Input data: {"left_right_fixture": {"left": {"t": [1, 3, 5, 7], "val": ["a", "b", "c", "d"]}, "right": {"score": [20, 40, 60], "t": [2, 4, 6]}}}
    Reference result: {"claim": "source_reported_expected", "fresh_native_result": false, "status": "historical_source_claim", "value": ["result == Polars join_asof oracle"]}
    Contrasting result: {"claim": "source_reported_observed", "fresh_native_result": false, "status": "historical_source_claim", "value": "ibis-polars rejects the emulation's non-equality candidate join (TypeError: Only equality join predicates supported with pandas, probe-confirmed); forward/nearest strategies are permanently capability-gated there"}

### Catalogue descriptions

- **native**, ibis-polars; `strategy` / `{"_identity": [["strategy", "in", ["value", {"tag": "set", "value": [{"tag": "text", "value": "forward"}, {"tag": "text", "value": "nearest"}]}]]], "kind": "predicate", "value": {"clauses": [{"op": {"enum": "mountainash.core.capabilities.schema.ClauseOp", "name": "IN", "value": "in"}, "operand": ["forward", "nearest"], "path": "strategy"}]}}`; categories: unclassified: join_asof forward/nearest lowers to a non-equality candidate join; the ibis Polars backend rejects non-equality join predicates (TypeError: Only equality join predicates supported with pandas).
  Workaround: Use ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite, or polars/narwhals backends.
  Source: `mountainash.relations.backends.capabilities.ibis.dialects.ibis_polars.extensions_mountainash.relation:information[1]`

## ibis/ibis-sqlite — sub-day truncate raises on ibis-sqlite

Target: `FKEY_MOUNTAINASH_SCALAR_DATETIME.TRUNCATE`

### Illustration

    Input data: {"values": {"timestamp": ["2024-01-01T10:00"]}}
    Reference result: {"historical_source_claim": ["2024-01-01T12:00"]}
    Contrasting result: {"historical_source_claim": "sub-day truncate raises on ibis-sqlite"}

### Catalogue descriptions

- **native**, ibis-sqlite; `unit` / `{"_identity": {"tag": "text", "value": "1h"}, "kind": "exact", "value": "1h"}`; categories: unclassified: ibis-sqlite has no TimestampTruncate support for units finer than DAY, and no TimestampBucket compilation rule (blocks multiple>1 bucketing, which quarter needs); verified 2026-08-16, ibis 12.0.0
  Source: `mountainash.expressions.backends.capabilities.ibis.dialects.ibis_sqlite.extensions_mountainash.datetime:information[0]`
